subject.why: The pineapple is instantly recognisable, complete with its golden body, green crown, and the requested cocktail umbrella.

category.why: The background colour does not contrast with the whole object; having a green wall behind the spiky green crown violates the requirement for contrasting colour.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: Well-centered composition with ample margins on all sides and no cut-off elements.

colour.why: The green crown blends directly into the green background wall, failing the clear separation requirement.

detail.why: No noisy micro-textures or busy patterns; shapes are simplified and clean.

style.why: Matches the 3D toy-like look with chunky volumes, soft lighting, and satin sheen.

fix: Change the green background wall and surface to a contrasting warm colour family, such as coral or pink, so the green crown cleanly separates from the background.
